run_fft: run fft on an array with a namespace, specifying n, axis, and norm parameters
run_fftn: run multi-dimensional fft on an array with a namespace, specifying s, axes, and norm parameters
run_rfft: run real-valued fft on a float array with a namespace, preserving float32 precision as complex64
run_hfft: run hermitian-significant fft on an array with a namespace, returning float32 for complex64 input
run_fftfreq: run fftfreq with a namespace to generate frequency bins for a given n and sampling interval d
